tools.description: Return the read-only book manifest. Use when: Inspect public book identity and structure metadata. Do not treat manifest metadata as source-text evidence.
tools.name: book_manifest

tools.description: Read canonical source text by one LID or an inclusive LID range. Use when: Read source text after a LID has been located. Do not use for lexical discovery when no LID is known.

end_lid.description: Inclusive final LID in source reading order; for a search hit, use end_lid. Reads from lid's span start through end_lid's span end. Omit or null to read only lid's span.

lid.description: Known LID from this book's locating or structure results; for a search hit, use start_lid. Reads the node's canonical source span, including descendants.

tools.name: book_text

tools.description: Enumerate the complete set of literal-text occurrences in canonical source, returning stable source UTF-16 ranges, the total count, and a pagination cursor. Use when: Locate the first, previous, or every lexical occurrence before interpreting it. Do not use lexical exhaustiveness as proof of semantic exhaustiveness.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the preceding search result. Omit or null for the first page; preserve query, match_mode, scope, order and page_size on continuation. A changed source revision invalidates it.

match_mode.description: exact (default) matches unchanged text; normalized applies NFKC, full non-Turkic case folding and whitespace collapsing. Both locate literal occurrences, not semantic equivalents; result ranges use original-source UTF-16 positions.

order.description: document (default) returns earliest occurrences first; reverse_document returns latest first. Uses canonical source order, not lexical LID sorting. Combine before with reverse_document for previous occurrences.

page_size.description: Maximum literal occurrences per search page, 1..50, default 20. Does not change total_occurrences or exhaustive coverage of the requested literal scope; preserve it when using cursor.

query.description: Literal text to locate in canonical source, containing non-whitespace text and at most 4,096 Unicode scalar values. Exact mode preserves query whitespace; this is not a semantic question or regex. Read chosen hits using their start_lid/end_lid.

direction.description: before keeps hits ending at or before the reference span's start; after keeps hits starting at or after its end. Direction filters scope independently of result order.

lid.description: Known reference LID in this book. The relative filter excludes this node's entire source span, including its descendants.

relative_to.description: Optional before/after filter around a known LID, excluding that node's span. Intersects with within_lid when both are supplied.

within_lid.description: Known LID whose source span, including descendants, must contain each whole hit. Omit or null for no subtree restriction.

scope.description: Optional source scope using known LIDs from this book. Omit, null or {} searches the whole book; within_lid and relative_to intersect, and each whole hit must fit the resulting range.

tools.name: book_search_text

tools.description: Return context pointers for a LID: near adds tree adjacency and local edges, mid adds other concept or entity occurrences, and far adds long-range edges. Pointers contain no source text; use book_text to read it. Use when: Expand around a verified LID through deterministic context links. Do not treat pointers as source text.

granularity.description: Context reach: near includes tree adjacency and local relations; mid adds other concept/entity occurrences; far also adds long-range relations. Omit or null for near.

k.description: Maximum number of context pointers returned across all layers. Omit or null for 10; zero returns no items. Counts pointers, not characters or source passages.

lid.description: Known LID in this book to expand around. Returned items are context pointers; read their LIDs through the source-text tool for evidence.

tools.name: book_context

tools.description: Deterministically recall whole-book concept and entity candidates with match reasons, bounded previews, and complete occurrence LIDs. After choosing candidates, read their full evidence with book_text. Use when: Discover concept or entity candidates when the user may not know the graph display label. Do not treat previews as final evidence or silently select a candidate; read chosen occurrence LIDs with book_text.

anchor_lid.description: Optional known LID in this book to rank nearby candidates and previews. Omit or null for unanchored ranking; this does not restrict recall to a subtree.

limit.description: Maximum concept/entity candidates, 1..50; omit or null for 12. Inspect matched_count and truncated for candidate coverage; this does not limit occurrences within a candidate.

query.description: Nonblank concept/entity name, alias or descriptive terms for deterministic candidate recall from names and occurrence text. At most 4,096 Unicode scalar values, including surrounding whitespace; not literal occurrence enumeration.

tools.name: book_concept

tools.description: Project BookStructure to explain a LID's role in the whole-book spine, throughline, and key stops. Without at, return the whole-book overview; when the sidecar is absent, return explicit unavailable status. Use when: Inspect the structural role of a LID or the whole-book overview. Do not use as a source-text search surface.

at.description: Optional known LID in this book to locate its structural role or current route segment. Omit or null for the whole-book view; this is a location, not a natural-language query.

tools.name: book_structure

tools.description: Return a macro guided-reading route from BookStructure by expanding key stops along spine segments. It does not interpret natural language or read Reader or memory state; when the sidecar is absent, it returns explicit unavailable status. Use when: Choose macro reading stops from BookStructure. Do not use for semantic question answering.

at.description: Optional known LID in this book to locate its structural role or current route segment. Omit or null for the whole-book view; this is a location, not a natural-language query.

tools.name: book_guide_path

tools.description: Return the current paper's metadata projection while preserving value, source, evidence_lids, and confidence. It returns explicit unavailable status without a sidecar and never creates cross-paper relationships. Use when: Read the current paper metadata projection. Do not infer cross-paper relations.
tools.name: book_paper_metadata

tools.description: Return the current paper's lexicon projection for aligning term, abbreviation, and dataset candidates. It returns explicit unavailable status when the sidecar is absent. Use when: Align paper terms, abbreviations, and dataset candidates. Do not treat candidates as verified definitions without source text.
tools.name: book_paper_lexicon

tools.description: Return the read-only PaperReadingGuide projection, combining paper metadata and lexicon, BookStructure, graph, discourse, and source text into ten paper questions, a codebook, and abstract-reading aids. It never creates or changes persistent truth. Use when: Read a deterministic paper-reading projection. Do not use it to mutate persistent truth.

mode.description: Reading depth: skim, close or deep. Defaults to skim.

stage.description: Reading stage: passive, active, critical or creative. Defaults to passive.

tools.name: book_paper_reading_guide

tools.description: Answer a self-contained semantic question about explicit referents by resolving targets first and then reading source evidence around the frozen bindings. Use when: Answer definition, explanation, relation, or comparison obligations for explicit referents. Do not use for literal occurrence location.

obligations.requirement: State the activation condition at each location.
Compare whether equality activates each threshold, citing both passages.

examples.query: How do the activation conditions of the alpha threshold and beta threshold differ?

anchor_lid.description: Required known LID in this book anchoring referent resolution. It provides local context without restricting evidence retrieval to this node.

intent.description: Question kind: definition or explanation requires 1..3 targets; relation or comparison requires 2..3 separately named targets.

obligations.description: One to three answer requirements, each in its own requirement object; these guide evidence sufficiency for the requested answer.

requirement.description: One nonblank, independently checkable requirement the semantic answer must address.

query.description: Self-contained, nonblank semantic question about the named targets, with enough context to resolve referents. Use literal search for exact wording or first/previous occurrences.

targets.description: Explicit referents to resolve before reading evidence. Each item is nonblank and unique after trimming and lowercasing; name comparison/relation targets separately, not as one combined phrase.

tools.name: book_query

tools.description: Synthesize a caller-supplied discrete LID set without expanding retrieval, returning an answer whose citations are a subset of the input LIDs. Use when: Synthesize a caller-supplied, frozen set of LIDs. Do not expand evidence beyond the supplied LIDs.

examples.task: Summarize these two threshold conditions using only these passages; state any evidence gaps.

lids.description: Nonempty list of known LIDs selected as the complete evidence scope. Synthesis reads only these nodes and returns citations drawn from this list, without expanding retrieval.

task.description: Synthesis instruction for the supplied LIDs; omit or null to synthesize their content without an additional task.

tools.name: book_synthesize

tools.description: Open, refine, or close an ephemeral visitor guide session. Use when: Maintain a visitor-only ephemeral guided-reading cursor. Do not read Resident reader or memory state.

action.description: guide opens or refines an ephemeral visitor session and requires intent; close ends it and requires session_id. Defaults to guide.

anchor_lid.description: Optional known LID in this book to anchor guided reading. Omit or null when no location is chosen; unused for close.

feedback.description: Optional reader feedback to combine with intent when generating the next guide; unused for close.

intent.description: Nonblank natural-language reading goal, required on every guide action, including session refinement; unused for close.

session_id.description: Session identifier returned by an earlier guide call. For guide, omit or null to open a session, or supply it to refine that session; required for close.

tools.name: book_guide

tools.description: List bounded Routing Cards for the current active accepted artifact overlay.
tools.name: artifact_list

tools.description: Search current active accepted artifacts with deterministic bounded lexical ranking.
tools.name: artifact_search

tools.description: Read bounded records from a current active accepted artifact by opaque reference.

cursor.description: Read continuation; omit record_refs when using cursor.

items.description: JSON Pointer such as /title or /meaning/text; escape ~ as ~0 and / in a key as ~1.

record_refs.description: Opaque refs returned by artifact.search; mutually exclusive with cursor. Their count must not exceed limit.

tools.name: artifact_read
